title: angelica refracta var. yabeana
intro: Angelica refracta var. yabeana, commonly known as Korean angelica, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues due to its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Korean angelica include pain relief, fever reduction, and antispasmodic effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as volatile oils, flavonoids, and lignans. The bioactive constituents of Korean angelica, including angelan and ligustilide, have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-cancer, and neuroprotective effects, contributing to its potential therapeutic applications.
